title: Filter history by timezone-aware timestamp windows
lead: Run reports need a time window without fetching and filtering the entire displayed history in a client.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** history cursors, log schema changes, protection against clock skew, or changing stored timestamps and default log ordering.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: cmd_log filters item/action/by before timestamp ordering and limiting. U7 needs since/until. The owner selected time windows only with an inclusive lower and exclusive upper bound.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: CLI log parser/handler and shared timestamp helper if needed, history/log tests, command and agent references, and CHANGELOG.md.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Since includes an exactly equal instant; until excludes it. Z, explicit UTC offset and fractional seconds compare as instants.
- Time filters compose with item/action/by before limit; newest-first ordering and append-order ties stay unchanged.
- Missing bounds preserve current output. Empty windows succeed with an empty result; equal bounds are a valid empty window.
- Naive timestamps, malformed values and since > until fail with usage and no writes. A malformed stored timestamp encountered while time filtering is a named corrupt-state error, not a traceback or guessed instant.
- Windowed history survives interleaved union-merge append order; no per-entry cursor field is introduced.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Add --since and --until, parse them with stdlib datetime, require a timezone, and normalize for comparisons. Apply since <= entry.when < until, with either bound optional. Filtering precedes the existing sort/limit step; emitted when strings remain the originals.

Validate supplied bounds before reading/filtering entries. Time filtering must fail clearly on a malformed entry timestamp rather than silently dropping it. Keep the default path's existing behavior and history schema. Document that timestamp windows cannot define an exact run boundary under clock skew.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Run focused boundary/offset/fractional/composed-filter/union-order tests, then full unittest discovery, tracking check, and git diff --check.

Use the project's ignored TMPDIR for temporary test fixtures, and scoped
support.isolated_discovery only for fixtures that require outside-project
discovery. The repository acceptance commands, run against the implementation
checkout's code and state, are:

```sh
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer check --json
git diff --check
```

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One reviewed implementation commit with command contracts and regenerated tracking output.
